```sql
SELECT tempo
FROM team_seasons
WHERE team_id = 'houston' AND season = 2024;
```

```sql
SELECT attendance
FROM games
WHERE season = 2024
  AND tourney_round = 'National Championship'
LIMIT 1;
```

```sql
SELECT AVG(home_score + away_score) as avg_combined_score
FROM games
WHERE season = 2025;
```

```sql
SELECT 
  ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN home_score > away_score THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) as home_win_percentage
FROM games
WHERE season = 2021 
  AND season_type = 1 
  AND neutral = 0;
```

```sql
SELECT tourney_round, COUNT(*) as games_played
FROM games
WHERE season = 2024 AND season_type = 3
GROUP BY tourney_round
ORDER BY games_played DESC;
```

```sql
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT team_id) 
FROM team_seasons 
WHERE season = 2020 AND box_games > 0;
```

```sql
SELECT t.team_id, t.name, ts.rating
FROM games g
JOIN teams t ON g.away_id = t.team_id OR g.home_id = t.team_id
JOIN team_seasons ts ON t.team_id = ts.team_id AND g.season = ts.season
WHERE g.season = 2024
  AND g.tourney_round = '1'
  AND g.season_type = 3
  AND ((g.away_id = t.team_id AND g.away_score < g.home_score)
       OR (g.home_id = t.team_id AND g.home_score < g.away_score))
ORDER BY ts.rating DESC
LIMIT 1;
```

```sql
SELECT 
  g.season,
  g.home_name as champion,
  ts.rating_rank
FROM games g
JOIN team_seasons ts ON g.home_id = ts.team_id AND g.season = ts.season
WHERE g.season BETWEEN 2021 AND 2026
  AND g.tourney_round = 'National Championship'
  AND g.home_score > g.away_score
UNION ALL
SELECT 
  g.season,
  g.away_name as champion,
  ts.rating_rank
FROM games g
JOIN team_seasons ts ON g.away_id = ts.team_id AND g.season = ts.season
WHERE g.season BETWEEN 2021 AND 2026
  AND g.tourney_round = 'National Championship'
  AND g.away_score > g.home_score
ORDER BY season;
```

```sql
SELECT team_id, name, def_eff
FROM team_seasons
WHERE season = 2026 AND team_id IN ('houston', 'tennessee')
ORDER BY def_eff ASC;
```

```sql
SELECT team_id, name, orb_pct
FROM team_seasons
WHERE season = 2024 AND team_id IN ('kansas', 'kentucky')
ORDER BY orb_pct DESC
LIMIT 1;
```

```sql
SELECT 
  game_id,
  date,
  home_name,
  away_name,
  home_score,
  away_score,
  (home_score + away_score) as combined_points
FROM games
WHERE season = 2026
ORDER BY (home_score + away_score) DESC
LIMIT 5;
```

```sql
SELECT DISTINCT tg.team_id, t.name, COUNT(*) as march_wins
FROM team_games tg
JOIN teams t ON tg.team_id = t.team_id
WHERE tg.season = 2025
  AND tg.date LIKE '2025-03%'
  AND tg.win = 1
GROUP BY tg.team_id, t.name
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 10
ORDER BY march_wins DESC;
```

```sql
SELECT AVG(home_score + away_score) as average_combined_score
FROM games
WHERE date >= '2026-03-01' AND home_score IS NOT NULL AND away_score IS NOT NULL;
```
